description: Source file implementing QboneServerSession class and related functions for handling QUIC server sessions in the Qbone protocol within the quic namespace.

classes.name: QboneServerSession
classes.description: Manages a Qbone server session, handling control streams, packet processing, and encryption levels.

classes.name: QboneCryptoServerStreamHelper
classes.description: Helper class for handling client hello acceptance based on ALPN.

methods.name: CanAcceptClientHello
methods.description: Checks if the client hello message can be accepted based on ALPN.

methods.name: QboneServerSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing a Qbone server session with configuration and network parameters.

methods.name: CreateCryptoStream
methods.description: Creates a new crypto stream for the session.

methods.name: CreateControlStream
methods.description: Creates and activates a control stream if not already created.

methods.name: CreateControlStreamFromPendingStream
methods.description: Creates a control stream from a pending stream.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Sets the default encryption level and creates control stream if level is forward secure.

methods.name: SendClientRequest
methods.description: Sends a client request over the control stream.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromNetwork
methods.description: Processes a packet received from the network.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromPeer
methods.description: Processes a packet received from the peer.

methods.name: SendPacketToClient
methods.description: Sends a packet to the client.

methods.name: SendPacketToNetwork
methods.description: Sends a packet to the network via the writer.
